title: Investment Philosophies - The 2026 Edition
description:
An investment philosophy is a cohesive set of beliefs about markets - how they work and sometimes do not - and how you think you can create strategies that take advantage of these mistakes. Contrary to conventional wisdom, there is no one right philosophy that should be adopted by all investors, but there is a right philosophy for you, one that fits your capital, capacities and personality. In this class, I look at competing philosophies, and while there is a prior version of this class that I made accessible almost 20 years ago, I have updated the class to include the investment choices and markets that have developed since. It accompanies the third edition of my investment valuation book (though you can take the class without the book, if you have budgetary constraints):
Investment Philosophies Book: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/webcastinvphil2025.htm
Investment Philosophies class: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/webcastinvphil2025.htm
